hypotheses.text: Line choice is largely irrelevant because the L1000 activity label reflects a shared systematic response; any second line should often reproduce the first label, maximizing paired compounds.
hypotheses.prediction: Second-line labels agree with first-line labels across most compounds and lines.

hypotheses.text: Line choice matters because tissue context changes measured response; selecting a line with distinct biology from A375 should increase discordance and yield one active plus one inactive per compound.
hypotheses.prediction: Second-line labels diverge from first-line labels more for biologically distant lines.
